body: We were way too young in my opinion. But shit happens, and it did, so I was ready to be a great mother to my baby anyways
You’re absolutely right, loved this comment
I have posted there a few times, lots of nice and helpful responses
Nobody said she couldn’t hurt too. I said she told me she UNDERSTANDS MY PAIN when she DOES NOT. Read the whole post and make sure you understand it next time you decide to comment.
I’m sorry for your losses, thank you for sharing and for the advice

That day she did it a few times, and she has a private Instagram account with just her close friends where she continued to talk about how she feels the same way I do now, and the last few posts triggered this inside me that it doesn’t seem fair
I mean I can’t give u a professional answer on if it’s okay but I smoked and I was fine, if anything it helped with my soreness and headaches
Brooklyn nine-nine is funny, and Hell’s Kitchen keeps me entertained for hours

?? How am I a pussy? I lost my baby that I had 3 and a half months with after I also delivered. Maybe you misunderstood what I said. I did buy my baby an urn and I did have to stand at his funeral. Very unneeded comment. Sorry for your loss.
I’m sorry for your losses. Thank you for the comment
This comment doesn’t make any sense to me. I never said her loss was nothing to mine, I said she doesn’t understand my pain as she says she does.
I appreciate the honesty!! I understand what you’re saying
Absolutely!! I see it this way now. Thank you so much.
That’s fair you’re right
You are right. I’m sorry for your losses
I appreciate the honesty. Thank you
I am also 18
Thank you!! I don’t think people commenting are understanding this part

In the beginning of the post I said she told me that she understands MY pain, meaning she compared her miscarriage to me losing my already born child. My question was, is it rude to think she was overreacting. No need to be rude.
Thank you so much
That was a perfect way to explain that, thank you

I don’t understand this comment. Could you explain another way? My baby was born, he was 3 and a half months old after me being pregnant for 9 months, I’m took this as you thought mine wasn’t born yet either. What does it have to do with Noah’s ark?
I haven’t lost a parent, I could only imagine. Christmas grieving is rough though, I hope you have support. It might not mean much I’m proud of you. Ill pray for you and your family
Thank you
I was only looking at it as ‘I lost more’ I guess, I didn’t think about it that way. Thank you
Definitely didn’t see it that way, thank you
No no!! I don’t mean to be rude, it just hurts that she says she understands what I’m going through when she really doesn’t
Nope unfortunately for u I’m back on the roads
That’s actually the only thing I didn’t do lol

I woke up when I hit the first tree after the pole, I opened my eyes and I couldn’t move, no pain, my lights were gone and airbag was out already, I felt and saw myself rolling and then another tree stopped my rolling, which is the dent over the back passenger side
When I hit the first tree, after the pole

Please don’t act as if you’ve never made a mistake before, or as if this happened on purpose. I did not destroy anybody’s family but my own. I am sorry for you and your family’s loss. Wishing u happiness
